title: Evaluation of tumour infiltrating lymphocytes in luminal breast cancer using artificial intelligence.
summary: The primary study applies supervised CNN segmentation/quantification to tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes in luminal breast cancer and reports outcome associations in discovery/test and external cohorts. Preserve the mixed finding: tTIL results were prognostic while AI-derived sTIL proportion was not. The study does not establish external generalization, causal effects or sustained operational impact.
